subject: Plan change: Saturday community clean-up
text:
Hi,

I’m writing to adjust our plan for the Saturday community clean-up because the parking lot by the river entrance closed suddenly after a maintenance report this morning. We need a straightforward workaround, and I think the best option is to meet at the east library lot instead, which is dry, paved, and still a short walk from the path. If anyone is relying on public transport, the 12 route stops within five minutes of the new meeting point. I will arrive at 8:45 to put up signs and check that the first aid kit, gloves, trash bags, and grabbers are all in the cart. Please bring water and wear closed-toe shoes, since we may detour through the grassy bank if volunteers spread out. If the weather turns, we will postpone until next Saturday, and I will send a text update by 6:30 that morning. Do not assume the original plan is still in place. When you confirm attendance, reply only if you can meet at the library or need help getting supplies. We still expect around twenty helpers, so if you know someone who may not have read the message, please tell them before noon. If your car is already registered for the old parking permit, I can refund it, but do not drive into the closed lot. This change is annoying, but it keeps us legal and keeps the activity moving. Thanks for rolling with the change, and see you early if all goes according to the new route.
